quickAnswers.label: HSM core question
quickAnswers.value: Many HSM holders are not under inburgeringsplicht on their temporary work permit — but still need civic integration proof for permanent residence or citizenship.

quickAnswers.label: Wi 2021 / B1
quickAnswers.value: If you became obligated on or after 1 January 2022, Wet inburgering 2021 applies. The common B1-route targets Dutch at B1 (with possible A2 step-down after proven effort).

quickAnswers.label: KNM
quickAnswers.value: Kennis van de Nederlandse Maatschappij — civic knowledge exam. Content and style updated from 1 July 2025; use current DUO practice materials.

quickAnswers.label: Official body
quickAnswers.value: DUO runs exams and obligation admin via inburgeren.nl. IND assesses the separate integration requirement for stronger residence.

sections.heading: Overview
body: Inburgering is the Dutch civic integration system: language skills plus knowledge of Dutch society (and, on some routes, labour-market modules). Expats often ask two different questions at once: “Am I legally obliged to integrate now?” and “What exams will I need later for permanent residence?” Those are related but not identical.

This page is the authoritative ExpatLife guide for that planning. It sequences Wet inburgering 2021 (Wi 2021), the B1 default learning goal, how Highly Skilled Migrant (HSM) status usually differs from obligated family or asylum routes, what KNM is after the 1 July 2025 update, and where DUO and IND fit. It is not legal advice and does not restate decision rules as if ExpatLife were IND or DUO.

callout.title: Orientation only — confirm on DUO and IND
callout.text: Obligation, deadlines, exam levels, fees, and exemptions change. Start with your IND decision letter and inburgeren.nl for your cohort.

sections.heading: Wet inburgering 2021 and the B1 default
body: If you became subject to the civic integration obligation (inburgeringsplicht) on or after 1 January 2022, IND points you to the Civic Integration Act 2021 (Wet inburgering 2021 / Wi 2021). Under Wi 2021, municipalities play a central role: they help place you on a learning route and a personal integration and participation plan (PIP).

Wi 2021 uses three main learning routes. The common B1-route aims at Dutch language level B1 (CEFR) plus civic knowledge exams. An education route (O-route) targets B1 or B2 with a school pathway. A self-reliance route (Z-route) exists for people who cannot reach B1 within the normal framework — confirm details with your gemeente and DUO.

People who still talk about “A2 only” are often describing older Wi 2013 exams or the IND secure-residence minimum. For Wi 2021 obligated newcomers, B1 is the default goal on the B1-route; municipalities may allow stepping down to A2 after substantial documented effort (DUO and Divosa guidance describe conditions such as many hours of recognised tuition). Always verify your route in your PIP — not on a forum post.

callout.title: B1 vs A2 for permanent residence
callout.text: IND’s integration requirement for a more secure residence permit is not the same as Wi 2021 obligation. IND often accepts a civic integration diploma at least at A2, or a Wi 2021 certificate / recognised exemption. Check the IND civic integration page for the evidence list that matches your application.

sections.heading: Who is obligated vs exempt — HSM and other permits
body: Two different legal ideas get mixed up in expat chats:

Inburgeringsplicht (civic integration obligation) — you must follow a programme and pass exams within a deadline (often three years). DUO administers this obligation. Family reunification and some other routes commonly trigger it; many Highly Skilled Migrants on a temporary work permit are not placed under this obligation solely because of HSM status. That is a planning pattern, not a personal guarantee — always read your IND decision letter.

Integration requirement for a more secure residence permit — when you apply for permanent residence, EU long-term resident status, or certain other stronger permits, IND usually requires civic integration proof (diploma, Wi 2021 certificate, or an exemption / dispensation IND accepts). This can apply even if you never had inburgeringsplicht during your HSM years.

So the HSM answer is usually: you may not have to inburgeren to keep working on HSM today — but if your plan is “stay if I lose the sponsor,” permanent residence and citizenship typically bring integration proof back into scope. Start exams early enough that certificates exist before you need them.

callout.title: Do not assume from nationality alone
callout.text: EU/EEA and Swiss citizens follow different free-movement rules. Non-EU HSM holders still need to verify their own letter. Exemptions (age, school-age residence, medical grounds, sufficient integration documents, and others IND lists) are case-specific.

sections.heading: Exam components and KNM after 1 July 2025
body: KNM means Kennis van de Nederlandse Maatschappij — Knowledge of Dutch Society. It is the civic knowledge exam newcomers take as part of inburgering (alongside language skills). Language exams typically cover reading, writing, speaking, and listening. Wi 2021 obligated routes also include participation elements such as the participation statement trajectory (PVT) and labour-market module (MAP) where your route requires them.

From 1 July 2025, the KNM exam is based on revised end terms (eindtermen). Government and Cito communications describe a shift toward testing knowledge of how Dutch society works (including themes such as women’s self-determination and Holocaust awareness) rather than older behaviour-style “what should someone do?” questions. Practice materials from before that date can be partly outdated.

DUO takes the exams. Use current practice exams on inburgeren.nl — not third-party quizzes as the source of truth. Exam fees, pass scores, and booking rules live on DUO; we do not republish numbers that go stale.

callout.title: KNM is not “on-site culture day” content
callout.text: KNM is an official exam administered by DUO. Prepare with current official practice materials. Government news of 30 June 2025 confirmed the revised KNM end terms apply from 1 July 2025.

sections.heading: DUO, IND, and your gemeente
body: DUO (Dienst Uitvoering Onderwijs) is the official body for civic integration exams and much of the obligation administration. English information and exam practice live at inburgeren.nl. Book exams and track results there — not through unofficial marketplaces.
IND decides residence permits and assesses the integration requirement when you apply for a more secure residence status. IND does not replace DUO as the exam organiser.

Your gemeente (municipality) is central under Wi 2021 for people who are obligated: learning route, PIP, and course referrals. Course availability and quality vary by city. Keep a folder with IND letters, DUO results, and gemeente correspondence — you will need it for PR or naturalisation later.

sections.heading: Links to permanent residence and citizenship
body: Integration certificates often reappear when you apply for permanent residence or naturalisation — even if your original HSM permit never mentioned exams. Plan language and KNM as part of a five-year stay timeline, not a last-minute scramble.
Permanent residence stabilises stay rights without requiring Dutch nationality. Citizenship is a separate step with additional nationality rules. Read both guides when you map years three to five.

How to sequence (orientation): confirm whether you have inburgeringsplicht now → if not, decide whether PR/citizenship is a goal → start language/KNM early → keep certificates ready before IND applications.
steps: Read your IND decision letter for any integration obligation or conditions.
If obligated under Wi 2021, follow your gemeente PIP and book DUO exams for your route.
If not obligated but aiming for PR or citizenship, plan civic integration evidence against IND’s secure-residence list.
Save diplomas, certificates, and exemption documents in certified-copy ready form.
Only then open permanent residence or naturalisation applications — confirm current IND checklists.

faq.q: Do I have to inburgeren on a Highly Skilled Migrant permit?
faq.a: Often you are not under inburgeringsplicht solely because of temporary HSM status — but that is not automatic for every person. Read your IND decision letter. Separately, permanent residence and citizenship usually require civic integration proof (diploma, Wi 2021 certificate, or an IND-recognised exemption). See the HSM and permanent residence guides.

faq.q: What is B1 under Wet inburgering 2021?
faq.a: B1 is a CEFR Dutch language level. Under Wi 2021, many obligated newcomers are placed on a B1-route that targets B1 language exams plus civic components. Stepping down to A2 can be possible after proven effort — confirm with your gemeente and DUO. IND’s secure-residence evidence list may still refer to A2 diplomas or Wi 2021 certificates; check IND for your application.

KNM (Kennis van de Nederlandse Maatschappij) is the Knowledge of Dutch Society exam. From 1 July 2025 it uses revised end terms with a stronger focus on factual civic knowledge. Prepare with current DUO practice exams on inburgeren.nl.

faq.q: Who runs the exams — IND or DUO?
faq.a: DUO runs civic integration exams and much of the obligation administration via inburgeren.nl. IND assesses residence permits and the integration requirement when you apply for stronger residence. Book exams with DUO, not IND.

faq.q: Is this the same as the old Culture “inburgering exams” page?
faq.a: This guide is the authoritative ExpatLife page for obligations, Wi 2021 / B1, HSM vs other permits, KNM 2025, and DUO/IND roles. The former culture orientation URL redirects here so there is one guide — not two competing articles.

faq.q: Do I need inburgering for permanent residence?
faq.a: Usually you must meet IND’s civic integration requirement (diploma at the level IND accepts, Wi 2021 certificate, or exemption / dispensation). That is separate from whether you had inburgeringsplicht on arrival. See the permanent residence guide and IND’s civic integration page.

faq.q: Can fines apply if I miss integration deadlines?
faq.a: If you are legally obligated (inburgeringsplichtig) and miss deadlines, DUO / IND processes can include penalties or residence consequences. Confirm deadlines on your letters and seek qualified advice if you are already overdue.
